# Alibaba Cloud
> Global cloud computing platform offering infrastructure, AI, data, security, and industry solutions for enterprises and developers.

Alibaba Cloud provides public cloud services, developer tooling, product documentation, API references, pricing, training, and support resources across compute, storage, networking, databases, AI, and security.

## Documentation
- [Documentation Home](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en): Central hub for Alibaba Cloud product documentation, guides, and references.
- [Product Documentation](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/product-overview): Browse documentation by product category and service area.
- [User Guides](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/user-guide): Task-oriented setup and usage guides for cloud services.
- [Developer Reference](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/developer-reference): Technical references for APIs, SDKs, and developer tools.
- [FAQ](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/faq): Frequently asked questions across products and account topics.
- [Best Practices](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/best-practices): Recommended architectures, operations, and implementation guidance.
- [Troubleshooting](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/troubleshooting): Diagnostic and issue resolution articles for common problems.

## API & Developer Tools
- [OpenAPI Explorer](https://api.alibabacloud.com/): Interactive API explorer for debugging and generating request examples.
- [Alibaba Cloud OpenAPI](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/openapi): Overview of OpenAPI usage, authentication, and integration concepts.
- [API Reference](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/api-reference): Product API operations, parameters, and response schemas.
- [SDK Center](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/sdk): SDK documentation and language-specific integration resources.
- [CLI Documentation](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/cli): Command-line tool documentation for managing Alibaba Cloud resources.
- [Terraform Provider](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/terraform): Infrastructure as code guidance using Terraform with Alibaba Cloud.
- [ROS Documentation](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/ros): Resource Orchestration Service templates and automation documentation.

## Compute & Containers
- [Elastic Compute Service](https://www.alibabacloud.com/product/ecs): Virtual machine service for scalable cloud compute workloads.
- [Simple Application Server](https://www.alibabacloud.com/product/simple-application-server): Simplified server hosting for lightweight applications and websites.
- [Container Service for Kubernetes](https://www.alibabacloud.com/product/kubernetes): Managed Kubernetes service for containerized application deployment.
- [Server Load Balancer](https://www.alibabacloud.com/product/slb): Traffic distribution service for high availability applications.
- [Auto Scaling](https://www.alibabacloud.com/product/auto-scaling): Automatically adjusts compute capacity based on demand.
- [Function Compute](https://www.alibabacloud.com/product/function-compute): Serverless compute platform for event-driven applications.
- [Elastic GPU Service](https://www.alibabacloud.com/product/elastic-gpu-service): GPU-accelerated compute instances for AI and graphics workloads.

## Storage, Database & Data
- [Object Storage Service](https://www.alibabacloud.com/product/oss): Scalable object storage for unstructured data and backups.
- [Apsara File Storage NAS](https://www.alibabacloud.com/product/nas): Managed network-attached file storage for shared workloads.
- [Hybrid Backup Recovery](https://www.alibabacloud.com/product/hbr): Backup and disaster recovery for cloud and on-premises systems.
- [ApsaraDB RDS](https://www.alibabacloud.com/product/apsaradb-rds): Managed relational database service for common database engines.
- [PolarDB](https://www.alibabacloud.com/product/polardb): Cloud-native relational database with high performance and elasticity.
- [ApsaraDB for Redis](https://www.alibabacloud.com/product/apsaradb-for-redis): Managed in-memory database service compatible with Redis.
- [AnalyticDB](https://www.alibabacloud.com/product/analyticdb): Real-time analytics database for large-scale data processing.

## Networking & CDN
- [Virtual Private Cloud](https://www.alibabacloud.com/product/vpc): Isolated virtual networks for secure cloud resource deployment.
- [Express Connect](https://www.alibabacloud.com/product/express-connect): Dedicated private connectivity between data centers and Alibaba Cloud.
- [NAT Gateway](https://www.alibabacloud.com/product/nat-gateway): Managed network address translation for internet access control.
- [Elastic IP Address](https://www.alibabacloud.com/product/eip): Static public IP service for cloud resources.
- [CDN](https://www.alibabacloud.com/product/cdn): Content delivery network for accelerating global content distribution.
- [Global Accelerator](https://www.alibabacloud.com/product/global-accelerator): Improves cross-region application performance and availability.
- [Web Application Firewall](https://www.alibabacloud.com/product/waf): Protects web applications from common attacks and exploits.

## AI, Machine Learning & Big Data
- [Machine Learning Platform for AI](https://www.alibabacloud.com/product/machine-learning): End-to-end machine learning development and deployment platform.
- [Platform for AI](https://www.alibabacloud.com/product/pai): AI platform for model training, inference, and MLOps workflows.
- [Elastic Algorithm Service](https://www.alibabacloud.com/product/eas): Model serving and inference platform for AI applications.
- [DataWorks](https://www.alibabacloud.com/product/dataworks): Data integration, development, governance, and orchestration platform.
- [MaxCompute](https://www.alibabacloud.com/product/maxcompute): Large-scale data warehousing and batch processing service.
- [Realtime Compute for Apache Flink](https://www.alibabacloud.com/product/flink): Stream processing service based on Apache Flink.
- [Elasticsearch](https://www.alibabacloud.com/product/elasticsearch): Managed search and analytics service based on Elasticsearch.

## Security & Identity
- [Security Center](https://www.alibabacloud.com/product/security-center): Unified security management for threat detection and protection.
- [Cloud Firewall](https://www.alibabacloud.com/product/cloud-firewall): Centralized network security policy enforcement and traffic control.
- [Anti-DDoS](https://www.alibabacloud.com/product/anti-ddos): DDoS mitigation services for internet-facing applications.
- [Key Management Service](https://www.alibabacloud.com/product/kms): Managed encryption key lifecycle and secrets protection.
- [SSL Certificates Service](https://www.alibabacloud.com/product/ssl-certificates-service): Certificate issuance and lifecycle management for HTTPS.
- [Resource Access Management](https://www.alibabacloud.com/product/ram): Identity and access management for users, roles, and permissions.
- [ActionTrail](https://www.alibabacloud.com/product/actiontrail): Audit logging service for account and resource operations.

## Learning & Training
- [Alibaba Cloud Academy](https://edu.alibabacloud.com/): Training, certification, and learning resources for Alibaba Cloud technologies.
- [Training Courses](https://edu.alibabacloud.com/course): Structured courses covering cloud products and architecture topics.
- [Certification](https://edu.alibabacloud.com/certification): Professional certification programs for Alibaba Cloud skills validation.
- [Hands-on Labs](https://edu.alibabacloud.com/lab): Practical labs for learning cloud services through guided exercises.
- [Developer Tutorials](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/tutorials): Step-by-step tutorials for building and deploying solutions.
- [Quick Starts](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/quick-start): Fast onboarding guides for common product scenarios.

## Support & Account
- [Support Center](https://www.alibabacloud.com/support): Entry point for technical support and service assistance.
- [Help Center](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help): Product help, troubleshooting, and operational documentation.
- [Submit a Ticket](https://selfservice.alibabacloud.com/ticket/createIndex): Create support cases for technical and account issues.
- [Service Status](https://status.alibabacloud.com/): Current operational status for Alibaba Cloud services and regions.
- [Contact Sales](https://www.alibabacloud.com/contact-sales): Reach Alibaba Cloud sales for product and solution inquiries.
- [Pricing](https://www.alibabacloud.com/pricing): Pricing information and billing models for cloud services.
- [Free Trial](https://www.alibabacloud.com/campaign/free-trial): Trial offers for evaluating Alibaba Cloud products.
